g.text: Five SER models: what changes when more votes must agree?
Each point is a different vote rule on the same samples: ≥3/5, ≥4/5 or 5/5.
Square = all five agree. More coverage means more labels are accepted automatically.
Samples auto-labelled (%) = accepted samples / common samples
Correct auto-labels (%) = correct labels / accepted labels
Each dataset uses the same five SER models. Lines connect discrete vote rules; they are not fitted curves.
